title: City — maps & the real world
body: The big scale. I love taking real-world data — open building maps, point clouds, GPS — and turning it into something you can actually move through. Digital twins you fly into, AR that sticks to an actual street corner. There’s something a bit magic about a phone that knows exactly where it is in the world.

title: Room — games, apps & toys
body: Human scale: the stuff people actually pick up and play with. Games, apps, websites, VR you can step into. This is where I get to be playful — a tiny mobile game one week, a training sim the next. If it makes someone smile or quietly learn something, even better.

title: Chip — tools & the nerdy bits
body: The smallest scale, and honestly my favourite to nerd out on: the tools, computer vision, AI and plumbing nobody ever sees. Cross-platform frameworks, synthetic data, characters that can hold a conversation, the backends quietly holding everything up. Build a good tool once and it pays you back forever.
